thesis:
This run successfully re-entered long positions on three top picks from the Quality Matrix, leveraging their strong composite scores and exceptional drilling results. The positions opened are:

1. **GR Silver Mining Ltd. (GRSL.V)**: Exceptional silver grade at 308 g/t over 101.6m (PAAS anchor); Moderate drill program type.
2. **A2 Gold Corp. (AUAU.V)**: Exceptional gold grade at 93.3 g/t (≥45 g/t); Moderate drill program type.
3. **Marimaca Copper (MC2.AX)**: Strong copper grade at 2.2% over 424m (NGEx Lunahuasi anchor); Moderate drill program type.

These positions were opened despite the churn guard due to their compelling quality metrics and the absence of significant bearish news.
